metas.name: The Beast in Me
metas.description: A grieving author becomes obsessed with her charming neighbor, whose wife disappeared. A slow-burn psychological thriller about suspicion, obsession and a man who may be a monster.

metas.name: Yellowjackets
metas.description: A high school girls' soccer team stranded in the wilderness turns on itself, and the survivors are still hiding what happened decades later. Teen cruelty, social pecking orders and psychological horror with real stakes.

metas.name: The Price of Confession
metas.description: A woman accused of killing her husband is offered a deal by a mysterious stranger: to prove her innocence, she must commit a murder. A twisty Korean psychological thriller built on moral compromise.

metas.name: Dexter: Resurrection
metas.description: The serial killer with a code wakes from a coma and heads to New York to find his son as his past closes in. A darkly funny crime thriller that keeps the suspense going episode to episode.

metas.name: Sharp Objects
metas.description: A journalist returns to her hometown to cover murders of young girls and runs up against her domineering mother. It's dark, controlled Southern gothic with a devastating final reveal.
